Run: `rowProblems` of the metrics `constructor`, `toString`, `valueOf` and `__proto__` with min 0 and max 1 returns `[]`, so the `design target` static check passes them. Then `metricValue('constructor', samples)` returns the samples array, and `measureTargets` puts it in `value` with result `out`, `metricValue('toString', samples)` returns the string `[object Undefined]`, and `metricValue('__proto__', samples)` and `metricValue('valueOf', samples)` throw `TypeError`. `metricValue` at line 217 reads `CALCS[metric]` the same way.
